parameters.name: PolicyDocument
parameters.description:
The document of the permission policy.

The document must be 1 to 6,144 characters in length.

parameters.name: PolicyName
parameters.description:
The name of the permission policy.

The name must be 1 to 128 characters in length and can contain letters, digits, and hyphen (-).

parameters.name: SetAsDefault
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to set the policy version as the default version.

*   false (default)
*   true

example.unifiedCli: aliyun resourcemanager create-policy-version --policy-name OSS-Administrator --policy-document Statement_:_Action_:_oss:0_,_Effect_:_Allow_,_Resource_:_acs:oss:0:0:0_,_Version_:_1 --set-as-default false --api-version 2020-03-31 --region cn-hangzhou
